writingSystem.name: Modern Greek alphabet
writingSystem.segmentation: Words are separated by spaces; grapheme-to-sound instruction requires reviewed Modern Greek rules

pronunciationPriorities: Begin with the reviewed sounds already present in el-letters-1
transliterationPolicy: Use only as optional temporary support and fade it as Greek-script recognition develops.
scriptSupportPolicy: Introduce Greek graphemes through saved audio and bounded recognition tasks.
morphologySyntaxProgressionNotes: Not defined by this migration slice; qualified review is required before expansion

principles: Retain only the existing authored examples while this package remains a draft

formulaicLanguagePolicy: No new formulaic language is approved by this migration slice.
pragmaticNorms: Neutral everyday register is the provisional target; qualified review remains pending
regionalVariation: Regional variants are outside the current prototype and require explicit review
culturalRepresentationRules: Do not infer cultural claims from a script-and-sound lesson
speechConstraints: Saved audio supports listening and self-comparison only
ttsConstraints: Use the existing reviewed static TTS profile and committed MP3 assets
asrConstraints: No speech-recognition or pronunciation score is enabled
accessibilityInputConstraints: Every required check has a non-audio selectable response
requiredReviewerQualifications: Standard Modern Greek language and pedagogy reviewer
knownLimitations: Draft migration profile covering only the existing el-letters-1 prototype
